result.markdown:
# Power Failure Outage on Site S-SAH-005

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SAH-005`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence, matching KPI drop timeline, and checked configuration changes rule out other causes.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 02:15 to 2026-09-11 03:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 00:19
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005

## Summary

Site S-SAH-005 experienced a mains power failure leading to battery depletion and subsequent site outage.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on site S-SAH-005 for 75 minutes.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 00:19: Mains failure alarm raised on S-SAH-005 [ALM-000197]
- 2026-09-11 02:12: Battery low alarm raised on S-SAH-005 [ALM-000198]
- 2026-09-11 02:15: Availability drop onset on S-SAH-005 [T5, ALR-0011]
- 2026-09-11 02:27: Critical site down alarm raised on S-SAH-005 [ALM-000199]
- 2026-09-11 03:30: Recovery of availability, active users, and traffic metrics [T5, ALR-0011]
- 2026-09-11 03:32: Mains failure, battery low, and site down alarms cleared [ALM-000197, ALM-000198, ALM-000199]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on S-SAH-005 for 1 hour starting at 2026-09-11 02:15. [ALR-0011, T5]
- Mains failure occurred on S-SAH-005 at 2026-09-11 00:19. [ALM-000197]
- Battery low alarm triggered at 2026-09-11 02:12 preceding the site down alarm. [ALM-000198, ALM-000199]
- Parameter tuning on S-SAH-005 occurred at 2026-09-10 22:55. [CHG-2026-0028]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SAH-005 and its parents. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SAH-005: confirmed. Mains failure followed by battery depletion directly correlates in time with the site outage and KPI drops. [ALM-000197, ALM-000198, ALM-000199]
2. **bad_change** at S-SAH-005: rejected. Parameter tuning finished hours before the outage and did not impact site availability. [CHG-2026-0028]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0028: Occurred hours prior to the incident and unrelated to power loss.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect mains power supply stability on site S-SAH-005.
- Verify battery backup capacity and health on S-SAH-005.

## Sources

- `ALM-000197`: major MAINS_FAILURE on S-SAH-005, raised 2026-09-11 00:19, cleared 2026-09-11 03:32
- `ALM-000198`: major BATTERY_LOW on S-SAH-005, raised 2026-09-11 02:12, cleared 2026-09-11 03:32
- `T5`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-SAH-005'], metrics=['availability_pct', 'active_users', 'dl_volume_mb'], start=2026-09-10T18:00:00, end=20 -> Deviation in 3 of 3 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-11 02:15: S-SAH-005 availability_pct below baseline.
- `ALR-0011`: ended alert from 2026-09-11 02:15: 1 site(s) (S-SAH-005); region-level SAH; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb
- `ALM-000199`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-005, raised 2026-09-11 02:27, cleared 2026-09-11 03:32
- `CHG-2026-0028`: parameter_tuning on S-SAH-005 at 2026-09-10 22:55: Handover hysteresis fine-tuning on S-SAH-005
- `T4`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-10 18:00:00, end=2026-09-11 06:00:00, node_ids=['S-SAH-005'], include_ancestors=True) -> No maintenance window scheduled on S-SAH-005 and its parents between 2026-09-10 18:00 and 2026-09-11 06:00.

report.title: Power Failure Outage on Site S-SAH-005

confounders.why: Harmless parameter_tuning on S-SAH-005 84 min before the mains failure; the site went down hours later, when the batteries ran out, and neighbours with the same change were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Mains failure at S-SAH-005; the batteries lasted 2.1 h, so the KPIs stayed normal until they were exhausted. Trap: a parameter change on S-SAH-005 itself ran 84 min before the mains failure, so a hasty investigator blames it for the site going down. Settled by: (1) MAINS_FAILURE (major) and later BATTERY_LOW precede the SITE_DOWN, which is the power sequence, and a parameter change cannot cut the mains; (2) the KPIs were normal for hours after the change; (3) the same tuning went onto S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011 under the same ticket and they stayed up.
